subject: Request: One-time onboarding accommodation for Finova Health (VPC authz delay)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Brighton <emma.brighton@finovahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Finova onboarding accommodation (VPC authz gap)

Team — quick summary and ask.

Finova Health (deal FIN-4821) is sitting on a $780k ARR commitment (18-month SOW) and they've paused their security sign-off because our VPC authz hook (required by their security team) is not yet in the private deployment build. They expect the authz endpoint to unblock key workflows (service-to-service auth for private ingestion).

Customer ask: they want a commercial accommodation while we finish the authz scope. Specifically they asked for a one-time commercial concession to offset additional integration effort and delayed go-live. They are looking for an immediate credit rather than an extended discount.

My proposal (to expedite): offer a one-time credit up to $50k applied at first invoice post-signing + a MAP (mutual action plan) with a firm go-live milestone. If product can commit to an ETA and finance/legal are ok, we can keep the renewal intact and avoid churn.

Attachments: Finova_SOW_v1.pdf, Finova_integration_timeline.xlsx, proposed_MAP_v2.docx (draft MAP).

Timing: Procurement wants a decision by EOD Wednesday (9/13) to keep the project timeline.

Why exec involvement: this is outside standard discount bands for the AE; need approval for an exception and for the credit to be recorded as a one-time commercial concession.

Ask: Marissa — can you provisionally approve up to $50k one-time credit contingent on MAP + SOW? Karthik — can you confirm the VPC authz ETA and acceptable temporary workarounds? Vanessa — can you flag any accounting/legal constraints?

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Exec, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Finova onboarding accommodation (VPC authz gap)

Thanks Lauren — quick product update and recommendation.

Status: the VPC authz feature is scoped and in sprint; current ETA for a fully production-ready authz hook in Private (VPC) is 2028-10-30. That includes integration tests and the KMS/HSM key exchange we discussed. There is a possibility to ship a limited-surface temporary endpoint by 10/13 that would satisfy Finova’s immediate checks, but it’s not the full hardened path and would need product sign-off on security posture.

Risk: offering a long-duration commercial accommodation while the fix is several weeks away creates moral hazard — we should align the credit to a successful milestone (go-live) or cap it. I recommend: grant a smaller upfront credit (or pro-rated credit) with the remainder contingent on production go-live by 11/15. Operationally this lets us protect revenue while signaling good faith.

Concrete recommendation:
- Approve up to $50k total concession, but structured as: $15k payable at contract signature, $35k as a conditional credit if go-live by 11/15.
- Alternatively, convert to a 12-week usage credit capped at $50k (applied weekly) if procurement insists on immediate offset.

I can validate the 10/13 temporary endpoint feasibility by EOD Tuesday if needed.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP Product — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Finova onboarding accommodation (VPC authz gap)

Quick finance/legal note.

We need the concession documented with accounting treatment and clear recovery conditions. A one-time credit recorded against ARR will lower recognized revenue if applied immediately, so prefer conditional structure tied to milestones. If we do an upfront cash-back credit, get Legal to sign an amendment with clawback language.

Questions for Lauren/CS:
- Is this a binding ask from procurement or a negotiation tactic? (i.e., would they walk if we don’t grant credit?)
- Can we get them to accept milestone-tied credits? If yes, finance will accept the $15k upfront / $35k contingent split proposed by product.

Also: any precedent with other private deployment deals? We should keep the approval documented as an exception in the commercial playbook.

I’ve looped Legal on the email thread (will add once we have the final language). Please include an explicit clause in the MAP that ties credits to go-live acceptance criteria.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Finova onboarding accommodation (VPC authz gap)

Appreciate the concise options. I approve a conditional exception with the following requirements:

1) Credit cap: $50,000 total (one-time).
2) Structure: $15,000 upfront credit at signature; $35,000 contingent and payable only if Finova achieves production go-live by 2028-11-15 per the MAP acceptance criteria.
3) Legal: amendment + clawback clause required before any cash is applied. No exceptions.
4) Product: Karthik to confirm the 10/13 limited endpoint feasibility or commit to the 10/30 full delivery; MAP must show which path we’re pursuing.
5) CS/AE: Lauren to secure procurement agreement on the milestone language and provide weekly progress updates to the exec sponsor (me) until go-live.
6) Measurement: define 2-3 acceptance criteria (ingest succeeded end-to-end, successful authz during test harness, key exchange validated).

If there’s a pushback from procurement that requires changing the payment profile (larger upfront amounts), escalate to me immediately with the clear delta and rationale. This approval is contingent on Legal sign-off and a short summary doc for finance.

Good faith approval — keep the ask tight.

Marissa Cole
SVP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Brighton <emma.brighton@finovahealth.com>, Finova Health Procurement <procurement@finovahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Finova onboarding accommodation (VPC authz gap)

Thanks Marissa — we’ll proceed on that basis.

Next steps (owned):
- Lauren: get Procurement to sign the MAP with milestone language and forward to Legal by EOD Wednesday (9/13).
- Karthik: confirm whether a 10/13 limited-surface endpoint is feasible (EOD Tuesday) or confirm 10/30 as hard ETA.
- Vanessa: please draft the concession entry for finance and indicate where it should route for accounting.
- Legal (to be added): prepare an amendment template with the clawback clause; I’ll ask Procurement to sign that at the same time as the MAP.

Emma — appreciate your patience; we’ll circulate the MAP link and the amended SOW for signature within 48 hours.
